Account and Data Deletion

Last updated: 5 August 2026

Deleting the visible account is not always the same as deleting every server-side record. Complete deletion depends on Firebase re-authentication and backend administrator access.

Self-service steps

  1. Open Settings → Account.
  2. Export your data if required.
  3. Select Delete Account and confirm.
  4. Complete recent sign-in or re-authentication if Firebase requests it.

What should be removed

  • Firebase Authentication account, when re-authentication succeeds.
  • User profile, settings, private tasks, rewards and saved history.
  • User-created community data where deletion is supported.

Limitations

Community records that must be retained for integrity, audit or moderation may require manual administrator review. Orphaned group subcollections require backend cleanup.

Manual request

If self-service deletion fails, contact the project owner from the account email and include the Firebase UID shown in the Admin/Account area. Do not send passwords or API keys.
